elements.name: Early morning soft gold light with long shadows
Single-file queue of men and women seen from behind
Queue running in a long curve across the yard
Queue leading to a small ticket window
Young man with backpack, dark jacket and grey-green trousers as last in queue, nearest, seen from behind
Long-distance buses parked along one side

notes: Rebuild the queue: the four people on the left stand in a loose cluster facing the buses, and the young man stands apart instead of at the end of a line. Paint one long single-file curve that crosses the yard and ends at the ticket window, with the young man as its last, nearest member. Also keep the buses to one side only; right now they are parked on both sides.
